gmres.preconditioner: inverse diagonal of the Cayley left matrix

oscillator_channel_differences_from_cart: No Cartesian x/y grid and no hard lateral walls.
The transverse complete-shell basis is orthonormal; roof probability has no h_x*h_y factor.
All propagated amplitudes and sparse solves use complex128; no complex64 cast is made.
The spinor roof coupling is the projected K_N matrix acting only at the roof node.
Cartesian--oscillator representation discrepancy is retained as a separate recovery error.

probability_convention.factorized_scalar_midpoint: pre/post longitudinal detector-Cayley substep; transverse phase applied afterward
probability_convention.integrated_detector_probabilities: direct sums of midpoint step probabilities
